builtin_contracts.test: test/[ support empty=false, one string nonempty, !, -n/-z, =/!= string bytes, -eq/-ne/-lt/-le/-gt/-ge decimal integers, -e/-f/-d/-L/-r/-w/-x PATH via authority, parenthesized -a/-o with ! > -a > -o. [ requires final ]. [[ supports &&/||, !, parentheses, ==/!= with unquoted glob RHS, =~ ERE with literal quoted RHS. Malformed operands/status2. No secondary execution.
builtin_contracts.identity: Host identity queries use actual permitted platform facts and screened output; fixture-user/fixture-host are synthetic expectations only. id default uid/gid/group numeric stable formatting; -n names via platform adapter where authorized; missing capability explicit.
builtin_contracts.date: Default UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; -u explicit UTC. +FORMAT supports %Y %m %d %H %M %S %s %z %% and literal text; no ambient locale; unsupported directive rejects. Clock captured once per operation.
builtin_contracts.environment: export/unset invocation local; env -i empty permitted environment then explicit assignments; -u remove named values. Blocked host-internal keys remain forbidden. printenv emits NAME=VALUE byte-sorted, named values LF, missing name status1; secrets screened, never implicitly resolved. Discovery uses same frozen PATH resolution as external dispatch.
builtin_contracts.paths: basename/dirname lexical native/logical component helpers with exact -- operands; basename strips exact optional suffix. realpath/readlink -f resolve canonical existing identity through authorized filesystem traversal; dangling target refuses; readlink default prints link text. cd no arg selects invocation initial cwd, not ambient home; cwd change local to frame. pwd emits logical cwd, native_path converts explicitly.
builtin_contracts.source: source -- exactly one path, no implicit execution from data; capture accepted snapshot/encoding, parse UTF-8 syntax, shared catalog/budgets, identify unit; body error retains earlier parent effects. Source syntax units require UTF-8 without BOM. Captured UTF-16/other encoding or BOM refuses COMMAND_OPERAND_INVALID when reached; earlier parent receipts/effects remain. Parse-buffer bytes are exactly captured source bytes, so UTF-8 byte spans never name raw UTF-16 offsets.
builtin_contracts.jobs: jobs lists session-owned handle/status in creation order; wait with no handle waits owned children; requested handle must belong session; kill accepts owned handles only. lsof -i :PORT/-iTCP:PORT/-sTCP:LISTEN is exact registered live listener query; ps session jobs only. Never process-name matching.
